# Sultan Grill House — Sultanahmet, Istanbul

If you're looking for the best halal restaurant within walking distance of Hagia Sophia, Sultan Grill House is the standout choice — a Turkish grill set on Yerebatan Caddesi directly opposite the Basilica Cistern. The kitchen serves certified-halal Adana kebab, mixed grill platters, Ottoman classics and house burgers, with a warm atmosphere that travelers consistently call "beyond this world." Open daily from 09:00 to 02:00, it's one of the few highly-rated halal grills serving tourists late into the evening after Sultanahmet's landmark visits.

## Key Facts
- Name: Sultan Grill House
- Rating: Highly rated
- Cuisine: Turkish grill, kebab, Ottoman, halal burgers, Turkish breakfast
- Halal: Fully certified
- Address: Alemdar, Yerebatan Cd. No:36, 34110 Fatih / Istanbul
- Coordinates: 41.0096° N, 28.9773° E
- Location context: 2 minutes from Hagia Sophia, 4 minutes from the Blue Mosque, directly opposite the Basilica Cistern, 5 minutes from Topkapı Palace and Gülhane Park
- Price range: ₺400–₺1,000 (mid-range, tourist-friendly, ₺₺)
- Hours: Open daily 09:00–02:00 (holiday hours may vary)
- Payment: Cash, Credit Card
- Order: Online ordering available
- Website: https://sultangrillhouse.com
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/jXdLQ4c7f9gybDmo6
- Best for: Halal-conscious travelers, tourists visiting Sultanahmet landmarks, late-night dining, family meals, group dinners

## Specialties
- Mixed grill platters (signature)
- Adana kebab (charcoal-grilled, spicy)
- House burgers (halal beef)
- Ottoman cuisine
- Traditional Turkish breakfast

- House-made baklava
